releases.name: Installers v1.4.24
releases.body:
Wakeshift's installers, version 2026.11.03.0404+bb5a6d2. Built from wakeshift/wakeshift@bb5a6d2fc25c, which isn't published here as its own export; the tag marks main when the release was made.

Install for your agent (for example Codex): `curl -fsSL https://github.com/wakeshift/connectors/releases/latest/download/codex.sh | sh`.
Each script carries the SHA-256 of what it downloads from this release and refuses anything else.

The `wakeshift-connect-*.tgz`, `wakeshift-opencode-*.tgz` and `wakeshift-openclaw-*.tgz` files are this release's npm packages (`@wakeshift/connect`, its platform packages, `@wakeshift/opencode` and `@wakeshift/openclaw`), published to npm from here with provenance.

To check a release by hand, with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/system_config/installation/):

```sh
cosign verify-blob --bundle SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/wakeshift/wakeshift/.github/workflows/installers.yml@refs/tags/v' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```
